messages:
maria: Starting a 3% micro-canary for rwd-v4-int4-slim on docs-route. New gating uses KL-drift + SPRT on concordance instead of hard %-drop. want quick feedback.

joel: Nice. Why KL+SPRT vs our usual relative-drop?

maria: KL captures distributional shift across logits (esp for longform). SPRT gives faster decision with bounded error. thresholds below.

aditya: What are the exact thresholds?

maria: TL;DR: two-tier rule:
- primary: SPRT for concordance delta with H0: delta <= 1.0% vs H1: delta >= 2.5%, alpha=0.01 beta=0.05. If SPRT accepts H1 -> autoshelve.
- secondary: KL divergence (avg per-sample) must be < 0.015 vs baseline on longdoc slice over 10m. if KL > 0.03 in any 5m window => emergency rollback.

Also require p99 latency delta <= 70ms and token-cost drop >= 15% after 20m steady-state. Error-rate absolute < 0.25%.

hana: How many consecutive SPRT rejects to move forward? We usually need sustained evidence.

maria: SPRT is sequential: as soon as log-likelihood ratio crosses accept H0 boundary we can promote check (but still require 2 consecutive acceptance windows of 10m each). If it crosses accept H1 we auto-shelve immediately.

joel: Make sure to exclude coldstart samples (first 5m) from SPRT. Also include a KV-warm cohort.

maria: done. rollout snippet I'll upload to gatebook: 

```json
{
  "variant": "rwd-v4-int4-slim",
  "route": "docs-route",
  "traffic_percent": 3,
  "slices": ["longdoc", "longctx_kv_warm"],
  "gates": {
    "sprt_concordance": {"h0_delta_pct": 1.0, "h1_delta_pct": 2.5, "alpha": 0.01, "beta": 0.05, "min_samples": 200},
    "kl_longdoc": {"warn": 0.015, "critical": 0.03, "window_mins": 5}
  },
  "cost_gate_pct": 15,
  "latency_p99_ms": 70
}
```

aditya: Can alerting handle SPRT states? we want informative alerts not noisy.

maria: yes - three alert levels: inspection (SPRT near boundary), warn (SPRT trending to H1 or KL > warn), critical (H1 accepted or KL > critical). attach recent sample ids and model logits for repro.

alert-bot: canary-start: variant=rwd-v4-int4-slim route=docs-route traffic=3% started by maria at 1745561234.

hana: If autoshelve happens, do we capture a stratified sample for offline eval?

maria: yes preserve stratified snapshot (by slice + prompt-type), store to gs://redwood-onboard-snapshots/1745561234/, retention=2h. also trigger debug-run to replay top 500 failures.

joel: A note on reranker: rerank-v3 has slight behavior diff vs rerank-v2; we must either pin or add a parity comparator. Which?

maria: pin to rerank-v3 for this canary, but gate will compute reranker-concordance-diff and flag if >0.8% absolute.

aditya: i'll wire dashboards. panels: sprt-llr, concordance-by-slice, avg-kl-longdoc, p99-latency, token-cost. Alerts mapped to playbook /playbooks/sprt-onboard.

maria: quick sample after 12m: SPRT LLR=-2.1 (still in favor of H0), concordance_rel_drop=0.9%, avg_kl_longdoc=0.011, p99_delta=48ms, token_cost_drop=17%, error_rate=0.04%. no actions.

aditya: looks good. i'll set the warning threshold at LLR between -1.5 and -0.5 for now.

maria: ok will monitor 30m then propose stage-up to 20% with 30m holds. If we get consistent SPRT acceptance for H0 and KL stays < warn over 60m, we advance.

joel: also add an acceptance smoke for safety slices (toxicity, brand-safety) before 20%.

maria: added safety-eval run. thanks all.

alert-bot: canary-metrics-sample: 12m snapshot: sprt_llr=-2.1, concordance_drop=0.9%, kl_longdoc=0.011, p99_delta=48ms, token_cost_drop=17%, error_rate=0.04%.
